messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] R.utils dependency issue
parts:
Hi,

thanks for reporting and sorry about this - a hiccup of mine (I've
been slowly pushing updates via the aroma server and am now pushing
them to CRAN). Retry with:

source("http://aroma-project.org/hbLite.R");
hbInstall("aroma.affymetrix");

and it should work. If not, please let me know.

/Henrik


On Thu, Oct 25, 2012 at 12:31 AM, Weng Khong Lim <weng...@gmail.com> wrote:
> I've been trying to install aroma.affymetrix (R-2.15.1 64bit Windows &) and
> have been running into problems when trying to load the library. If seems
> like the version of R.utils I have is not sufficient. ‘R.utils’ 1.16.2 is
> loaded, but >= 1.17.0 is required by ‘R.filesets’. Version 1.17.2 is not
> available in CRAN, so I downloaded it using hbGet (hbGet("R.utils",
> "tar.gz")) and tried manually installing it and got this error message:
>
> package ‘R.utils_1.17.2.tar.gz’ is not available (for R version 2.15.1)
>
> Any thoughts? I tried this on R-2.14 as well and seem to be running into the
> same problem.
>
> WK
>
>
> --
> When reporting problems on aroma.affymetrix, make sure 1) to run the latest
> version of the package, 2) to report the output of sessionInfo() and
> traceback(), and 3) to post a complete code example.
